_doc: Sandbox inventory for `pnpm isometric:coverage-check --source=fixture` (ADR 0005 scope rules / ADR 0018). One `facilities[]` entry per sandbox project we want CI to assert against — the check verifies the live Removal Template's monitored inputs are all covered by INPUT_MAPPING and that no PROJECT-scope period input is declared REMOVAL-scope. Refresh this file when the sandbox project's template changes (see `docs/isometric/sandbox-template-authoring.md`).
